Given the curve r(t)=⟨t3,et,et−1⟩, find all points at which r′(t) and r(t) are parallel.

a
(1,0,e−1) and (27,e3,e2)
b
(27,e3,e2)
c
(0,1,0) and (27,e3,e2)
d
(0,1,e−1) and (27,e3,e2)
e
(0,1,e−1)
